krūrā.m: krūrā (ā), f. a variety of Punarnavā with red blossoms

añjali.m: añjali/ See s.v. below.; añjali/ m. (√ añj), the open hands placed side by side and slightly hollowed (as if by a beggar to receive food; hence when raised to the forehead, a mark of supplication), reverence, salutation, benediction; a libation to the Manes (two hands full of water, udakāñjali), …

prahara.m: pra-hara &c. See pra-√ hṛ.; pra-hara m. (ifc. f(ā). ) a division of time (about 3 hours = 6 or 7 Nāḍikās; lit. ‘stroke’, scil. on a gong); the 8th part of a day, a watch; N. of the subdivisions in a Śākuna (q.v.)

vitatha.m: vi-tatha See s.v.; vi-tatha mf(ā)n. (fr. vi + tathā, not so) untrue, false, incorrect, unreal, vain, futile (instr. ‘falsely’; ˚thaṃ-√ kṛ, ‘to revoke, annul’),; &c.; free from (abl.); vi-tatha m. N. of Bharad-vāja; of a partic. class of domestic deities

vāṅmaya.m: vāṅ-ma/ya mf(ī)n. consisting of speech, depending on sp˚, whose essence is sp˚, relating to sp˚ (also -tva n.),; &c.; eloquent, rhetorical; vāṅ-ma/ya n. sp˚, language; eloquence, rhetoric, manner of sp˚,; &c.

śubha.m: śubha mf(ā)n. splendid, bright, beautiful, handsome (often f. voc., śubhe, ‘fair one!’ in addressing a beautiful woman),; &c.; pleasant, agreeable, suitable, fit, capable, useful, good (applied to persons and things); auspicious, fortunate, prosperous; good (in moral sense), righteous, virtuous, …
